image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), perched on a thin, leafless branch. The bird is facing left with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. It exhibits characteristic plumage: a greyish-brown head with dark streaks, an orange-rufous breast and flanks, a white belly, and brownish-grey wings with distinct white wing bars. The background is a soft, out-of-focus brown/green bokeh.
